assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless square grass albedo texture for a top-down stylized 3D puzzle game.
Primary request: Create a new autumn grass terrain texture matching the provided reference's warm orange-gold platform tops. A mostly quiet, flat matte carpet of dry autumn moss and short grass, with broad softly angular hand-painted color facets and gently mottled patches. Palette: golden ochre #c99543, muted pumpkin #bc7741, warm amber #d5a052, restrained russet #a9663e, a very little faded olive. Mostly golden-orange rather than brown. Sparse small clusters of short golden grass strokes and a few understated dry leaf shapes, with 90 percent broad quiet terrain. No dense leaf litter. Simplified painterly fantasy material consistent with low-poly geometry.
Composition: one full-bleed square image, orthographic exactly overhead; intended as an albedo tiled once over four by four board tiles. Seamless in both axes: matching opposite edges and all corners, no border or center motif. Even neutral illumination, no directional shadows, no lighting gradient, opaque RGB, 1024 x 1024.
Avoid: photo detail, long grass blades, emerald greens, isolated objects, flowers, stones, cliff edges, terrain island, sky, perspective, text, labels, watermark. Only the reusable continuous autumn grass surface.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless square rock albedo texture for a top-down stylized 3D puzzle game.
Primary request: Create a new warm pale limestone rock texture to pair with orange-gold autumn grass. Match the reference's creamy sandstone on platform TOPS. Continuous matte bedrock broken into broad irregular fitted polygonal plates, with softly chipped edges, delicate meandering taupe hairline cracks and subtle ivory edge accents. Dominant warm sandy cream #d4c6a3, pale beige #cbbd9f and muted warm grey #b8ae97. A slight ochre warmth ties this stone to an autumn environment while remaining distinctly pale and neutral beside orange grass. Broad quiet flat surfaces, gentle painted facets, occasional tiny pale stone chips, roughly 25 to 35 broad plates across the image. No grass or leaves: this is a separate pure rock layer for material blending.
Style: simplified hand-painted low-poly fantasy game material, smooth broad color shapes and restrained contrast. Albedo only with even neutral illumination.
Composition: one full-bleed square image, orthographic exactly overhead. Seamlessly repeating in both axes: matching opposite edges, cracks continue naturally across boundaries and all four corners match. Opaque RGB, 1024 x 1024. One repeat spans four by four game tiles.
Avoid: dark crevices, heavy outlines, regular paving or cobblestones, brick grids, photorealistic grain, directional shadows, lighting gradient, cliff sides, isolated boulders, islands, sky, perspective, objects, text, watermark. Only the reusable pale warm cracked rock surface.
